passages.text: Gaillardia amblyodon, the lanceleaf blanketflower or maroon blanketflower, is a species of flowering plant in the aster family. It has been found only in the state of Texas in the south-central United States.

Gaillardia amblyodon grows in open, sunlit locations on sandy soils. It is an annual herb up to {{convert|45|cm|in|abbr=on}} tall with leafy stems. Each flower head is on its own flower stalk up to {{convert|15|cm|in|abbr=on}} long. Each head has 8-12 red or purple (rarely yellow) ray flowers surrounding 30-60 disc flowers (yellow with purple tips). The species appears to be closely related to the more widespread G. pulchella.
